@graph.rdfs:label: CaseStudyWorkflow
@graph.rdfs:comment: A regulatory question of a VHP4Safety case study, or a step of the workflow that answers it: instructions (schema:HowTo) whose steps are workflows of their own, with the tools, methods, models and data used at each step. Version: 0.1-DRAFT.

name.title: Title
name.description: Shown on its button, as the heading of its page, and in the way back to it.

text.title: Text
text.description: For a question: the question. For a step: the text of its page above its sections, in HTML.

headline.title: Heading of its page
headline.description: The heading of its page, if it differs from the title.

description.title: Summary
description.description: Shown under the heading of its page.

disambiguatingDescription.title: Description under its button
disambiguatingDescription.description: For a step: shown under the title on its button.

position.title: Position
position.description: The order among the questions of the case study, or among the steps of the workflow above it. 1 is first.

additionalType.title: Process flow step
additionalType.description: For the steps of a question: the step of the VHP4Safety process flow, a term of the VHP4Safety glossary.

creativeWorkStatus.title: Status
creativeWorkStatus.description: Incomplete: its page has no content yet, so its button is greyed out and the page cannot be opened.

step.title: Steps
step.description: The steps of the workflow, each a workflow of its own at an address under this one. For a question, these are its process flow steps.

tool.title: Tools, methods and models
tool.description: Each tool, method or model used at this step, with the label and the description of its button.

supply.title: Data
supply.description: Each dataset used at this step, with the label and the description of its button.

input.title: Input
input.description: The input of a step, such as an estimated daily intake: a dataset, or a name if there is no record of it yet.

output.title: Output
output.description: The output of a step, such as an exposure calculation: a dataset, or a name if there is no record of it yet.

workflow.description: A step of the workflow (CaseStudyWorkflow profile).

section.description: A section of the page: a heading, a text in HTML and its position.

text.description: The text of the section, in HTML.

position.description: The order of the section on the page. 1 is first.

tool.description: A tool, method or model used at the step.

item.description: The tool, method or model: a link to its record, or its name if it has no record yet.

position.description: The order of its button among the tools and data of the step. 1 is first.

supply.description: A dataset used at the step.

item.description: The dataset: a link to its record, or its name if it has no record yet.

position.description: The order of its button among the tools and data of the step. 1 is first.

parameter.description: An input or output named only, until there is a record of it.

name.description: The name of the input or output.
